subject: Where is the tick labels with scale_x_discrete()

messages.author: 91c9897630bbc6e6
messages.subject: Where is the tick labels with scale_x_discrete()
parts:
Hi,

I could not make the tick labels displayed with scale_x_discrete().  
Here is the codes:

library(ggplot2)
dd <- data.frame(xx=1:10,yy=runif(10,0,5))
(c <- ggplot(dd,aes(xx,yy))+geom_bar(stat="identity"))
c+scale_x_discrete(breaks=c(1,5,10),labels=c("a","b","c"))

It seems the chart has breaks as c(1,5,10), but just no tick labels as c("a","b","c").

Any suggestion would be appreciated.
Thanks.

Wind

On Thu, Nov 4, 2010 at 5:18 PM, Kohske Takahashi <takahash...@gmail.com> wrote:
in your case, the xx is continuous variable.
so you can do that by either

ggplot(dd,aes(factor(xx),yy))+geom_bar(stat="identity")+scale_x_discrete(breaks=c(1,5,10),labels=c("a","b","c"))

or

ggplot(dd,aes(xx,yy))+geom_bar(stat="identity")+scale_x_continuous(breaks=c(1,5,10),labels=c("a","b","c"))


and probably ggplot2 list is more suitable for your question.
http://groups.google.com/group/ggplot2

kohske
